src.t: Georgia Secretary of State, 2026 Election Calendar and Highlights

items.head: DEADLINE TO PUBLISH QUALIFYING FEES
items.what: Deadline to publish qualifying fees. The last day for the Secretary of State and Election Superintendents to fix and publish 2026 qualifying fees for candidates running for federal, state, and local offices.

items.head: REGISTRATION DEADLINE FOR MARCH SPECIAL ELECTION/RUNOFF
items.what: Registration deadline for March special election/runoff. Last day for an applicant to register and for an elector to change address prior to the primary, election, or runoff.

items.head: 12PM CANDIDATE QUALIFYING WEEK/PERIOD FOR MAY PRIMARY AND NOVEMBER GENERAL
items.what: 12pm candidate qualifying week/period for May primary and November general. The qualifying period for a candidate to file and qualify to appear on the ballot.

items.head: LAST DAY OF ADVANCE VOTING FOR MARCH SPECIAL ELECTION
items.what: Last day of advance voting for March special election. Last day of advance voting.

items.head: DATE OF MARCH SPECIAL ELECTION
items.what: Date of March special election.

items.head: UOCAVA BALLOT RECEIPT DEADLINE
items.what: UOCAVA ballot receipt deadline. Eligible UOCAVA absentee ballots postmarked by election date and received within the three business days following the election deemed valid shall be counted.

items.head: ABSENTEE BALLOT CURE DEADLINE
items.what: Absentee ballot cure deadline. Last day voters can cure timely submitted absentee ballots for missing signature or information mismatch.

items.head: DEADLINE FOR COUNTY CERTIFICATION OF MARCH SPECIAL ELECTION
items.what: Deadline for county certification of March special election. Returns shall be certified by the superintendent no later than 5:00 P.M. on the Monday following the date on which such election was held, and such returns shall be immediately transmitted to the Secretary of State.

items.head: LAST DAY OF ADVANCE VOTING FOR SPECIAL ELECTION RUNOFF
items.what: Last day of advance voting for special election runoff. Last day of advance voting.

items.head: DATE OF SPECIAL ELECTION RUNOFF
items.what: Date of special election runoff.

items.head: REGISTRATION DEADLINE FOR MAY PRIMARY/NONPARTISAN ELECTION

items.what: Deadline for county certification of April runoff election. Returns shall be certified by the superintendent no later than 5:00 P.M. on the Monday following the date on which such election was held, and such returns shall be immediately transmitted to the Secretary of State.

items.head: DEADLINE FOR COUNTY CERTIFICATION OF MAY PRIMARY/NONPARTISAN ELECTION
items.what: Deadline for county certification of May primary/nonpartisan election. Returns shall be certified by the superintendent not later than 5:00 P.M. on the Monday following the date on which such election was held, and such returns shall be immediately transmitted to the Secretary of State.

items.head: CONDUCT RISK LIMITING AUDIT
items.what: Conduct risk limiting audit. Local election superintendents shall conduct risk-limiting audit on one federal or state-wide contests randomly selected by the Secretary of State during this period.

items.head: DEADLINE FOR STATE CERTIFICATION OF RETURNS
items.what: Deadline for state certification of returns. Last day for the Secretary of State's Office to certify the votes cast for federal and statewide contests.

items.head: JUNE RUNOFF ELECTION ADVANCE VOTING
items.what: June runoff election advance voting. Advance voting should commence as soon as possible prior to a runoff but not later than the second Monday immediately prior to such runoff.
